description.en: Developed a page builder and rendering engine for drag-and-drop website creation, frontend applications with Vue.js and Nuxt.js, and Node.js migration scripts for legacy data.
Contributed to a company product by developing a drag-and-drop website page builder and rendering engine, including live preview and publishing workflows.
description.id: Berkontribusi pada produk perusahaan dengan mengembangkan page builder situs web berbasis drag-and-drop beserta rendering engine, termasuk pratinjau langsung dan alur publikasi.

description.en: Developed Node.js scripts for converting and migrating legacy data.
description.id: Mengembangkan skrip Node.js untuk mengonversi dan memigrasikan data lama.
